scope: Game FPS screenshot stabilization, official game-release expansion, console hardware and selected retro history

identity.meaning: Canonical IDs group reviewed same-game editions where established. This count is not a claim of that many newly discovered unique underlying games. Cross-store aliases, remasters and editions may need additional curation.
examples: Fallout 3 and its GOTY edition share one canonical game ID while keeping their separate Steam app IDs.
Dark Souls II and Scholar retain separate edition records with a shared reviewed canonical game ID.
Nintendo native Switch 2 releases are separate from Switch releases; no blanket backward-compatibility claim is generated.
Xbox Series X|S official family listings stay grouped and cannot create individual measured Series X or Series S results.

evidence.pc: Steam public store listing metadata: exact app ID, Windows platform, developer, publisher, release information, observed timestamp and extracted-fact SHA-256.
evidence.sony: Exact title and product-specific PS5 platform field from official PlayStation game pages, not mentions of PS5 in site navigation.
evidence.nintendo: Exact base-game NSUID, available-now status and native platform code from official Nintendo collection metadata. DLC, upgrade packs and bundles excluded.
evidence.xbox: 21 exact Game product records from the official optimized catalog plus 87 exact SKU/platform announcements from five Xbox Wire weekly articles. Announcement dates stay separately labeled and do not prove current availability. No undocumented seller API or FPS estimate used.
evidence.hardware: 12 cited manufacturer specification/history pages; original 2020 PS5 scope, exact Switch revision and Xbox storage variants remain explicit.

publication.pcUnknownOrFutureReleaseHandling: Existing announced titles remain clearly labeled; no FPS is derived from an unconfirmed PC release.

performance.initialPcExpansionJavaScript: Compact metadata only; approximately 3.6 KB gzip for the current 110 records.
performance.consoleMetadata: Full console evidence JSON is requested only when a visitor opens a console view.

screenshotIssue.rootCause: Oversized legacy form styling, repeated missing-evidence prose, always-promoted synthetic demonstration and unbounded game result rendering.
screenshotIssue.fix: Scoped compact form, eight visual platform controls, one concise evidence result, optional methodology, removed synthetic estimator, bounded game lists and truthful image fallback.

fps.browser: Isolated headless Edge Chromium; not iOS Safari

consoleHardware.browser: Isolated headless Edge Chromium; not iOS Safari

limitations: Xbox catalog availability metadata covers 21 additional listings; another 87 exact SKU/platform entries are verified through dated official release announcements. Those 87 entries are not claimed to have a currently rechecked store availability or unchanged release date.
No newly measured PC or console FPS records were acquired. A verified game listing never becomes a measured benchmark.
No third-party game artwork redistribution rights were established. New entries use one clearly labeled original category illustration; existing legacy artwork needs its separate rights audit.
The retro section contains 16 hardware history landmarks. It is not a comprehensive retro game library.
Browser QA uses isolated Chromium Edge. Native iPhone Safari, virtual keyboards, screen-reader output and real-user Core Web Vitals remain separate checks.

Importers are bounded research commands, not an installed daily scheduler. Cached accepted records retain their original observation dates; invoking a command does not guarantee every old source was refreshed.
Platform storefront release dates can describe a port or edition rather than the original game launch. Exact regional scope is retained.
Console GPU output capability and display refresh rates do not establish game FPS or desktop GPU equivalence.
exactNextActions: Cross-check the 87 Xbox announcement entries against current exact store metadata before promoting their dates or availability beyond announcement status.
Extend the retro archive with individually verified game-platform releases before presenting it as a game library.
Obtain permitted benchmark datasets and exact test conditions; keep unsupported setups unmeasured.
Acquire properly licensed exact game artwork when redistribution permission is established.
Review cross-store edition and remaster relationships before making unique-game coverage claims.
Integrate the validated importers into the parent operations workflow with source freshness and review safeguards.
